messages:
alina: Heads-up — SkyBridge wants us to list their LLM in our marketplace. They attached a distribution clause that looks restrictive around weights redistribution. Need legal + eng alignment on whether this blocks Dedicated/Private listings.

matt_legal: Can you paste the clause? quick skim might tell us if we can proceed under our standard addendum or need redlines.

alina: Pasting the excerpt they sent:
```text
Section 4.2 Redistribution: Licensee may not redistribute the Model weights in raw or decompiled form outside of Licensed Platforms. Allowed distribution: runtime-only artifacts (quantized checkpoints, ONNX with obfuscation) that cannot be used to reconstruct original weights.
```

sara_product: Important nuance — if they prohibit redistributing raw weights, Private (on-prem/air-gapped) installs could be blocked unless a separate partner/customer agreement is signed. Need a clear product/legal matrix: Hosted ✅, Dedicated maybe (depends), Private probably 🚫 without exception.

raj_eng: From infra: Dedicated uses our managed storage and we can keep artifacts encrypted and controlled, so that usually passes. Private often requires handing over binaries to customer's infra — that would violate a no-redistribution clause unless the customer signs something. We should flag installer flows.

matt_legal: Agreed. Propose two immediate redlines for SkyBridge: (1) carveout for "customer-controlled private deployments under explicit NDA & security controls" and (2) a tighter definition of "runtime artifact" that allows quantized/obfuscated formats we can guarantee are non-reconstructible. I'll draft the redline today.

alina: Partner is hoping for a marketplace listing + joint announcement next month. We need: legal signoff, product metadata (size, model family, license label, redistributable flag), infra capability flags (download allowed?).

sara_product: I'll draft the marketplace metadata and UI copy. Suggest adding an explicit "Redistributable: Yes/No (see license)" toggle visible on the model card and in API responses.

raj_eng: Technical notes: if redistributable == No then we must: (a) disable direct artifact download, (b) disable Private installer packaging for that model, and (c) set catalog flag to refuse serving of raw checkpoints to exported runtimes. We can implement feature-flagged checks in the catalog service.

matt_legal: Also need to verify upstream license terms for the base model — they claim permissive, but their added redistribution prohibition could conflict with contributors/upstream license obligations. I'll check the provenance and raise any SPDX issues.

alina: I'll ask SkyBridge for clarification and propose our standard Marketplace Addendum as starting point. If they insist on their clause, legal will send a redline.

sara_product: Proposed joint announcement week of 2026-04-14. To hit that we need legal first-pass by 2026-03-25 and product/marketing assets by 2026-04-01. Is that realistic?

matt_legal: I can do a first-pass redline by 2026-03-25.

marketplace-bot: meeting scheduled with SkyBridge on 2026-03-26 10:00 PT — /invite @matt_legal @raj_eng @sara_product

alina: Thanks — quick check: who needs to join live? I'll be there, sara, matt, raj. If anyone else wants to observe, add yourself. :thumbsup: 

alina: Action items: matt_legal draft redline (due 3/25), sara_product prepare metadata + UI copy (due 4/01), raj_eng add infra flags + blocker list (due 3/30), alina coordinate partner & request clarification on clause.

sara_product: adding: include a catalog field in the API as "redistribution_policy" with values {"unrestricted","runtime-only","partner-only"} — keeping it explicit for integrators.

raj_eng: noted. I'll sketch an RFC for the catalog changes and link it in the meeting.

matt_legal: will include suggested language for the NDA carveout and runtime artifact definition in my draft.

alina: Great — let's reconvene after the 3/26 call and finalize marketplace listing. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
